ChangeSeverity.description: How significant the change is — determines approval requirements.
ChangeSeverity.title: ChangeSeverity

ChangeType.description:
Category of change being requested.

``makegood`` implements flagged decision FD-6: makegoods are a typed
ChangeRequest subtype, not a separate primitive.
ChangeType.title: ChangeType

MakegoodDetails.description:
Makegood payload for a ChangeRequest of type ``makegood`` (FD-6).

Sent when delivery falls short of the guaranteed level; the seller
responds with replacement inventory. Carries the compensation terms:
what is owed (``shortfall_grps`` for linear TV, ``owed_impressions``
for digital), the proposed replacement flight, and the makegood
``status``. The human-readable reason lives on the enclosing
:class:`ChangeRequest.reason` (not duplicated here). GRP = gross rating
point.

owed_impressions.description: Impressions owed for a digital makegood; None for a pure-GRP makegood.
owed_impressions.title: Owed Impressions

preferred_dayparts.description: Buyer's preferred dayparts for replacement inventory.
preferred_dayparts.title: Preferred Dayparts

replacement_flight_end.description: Proposed end of the replacement flight.
replacement_flight_end.title: Replacement Flight End

replacement_flight_start.description: Proposed start of the replacement flight.
replacement_flight_start.title: Replacement Flight Start

shortfall_grps.description: GRP shortfall owed that needs to be made up (linear TV).
shortfall_grps.title: Shortfall Grps

MakegoodDetails.title: MakegoodDetails

description:
Request body for ``POST /api/v1/change-requests`` (money-mutating: FD-12).

The seller mints ``change_request_id`` and owns the request's
lifecycle. Makegoods (GRP shortfall replacement, linear TV) and
cancellations are typed subtypes of this one surface — see the
module docstring for the retired per-deal sub-routes.

deal_id.description: Deal being modified; at least one of order_id/deal_id.
deal_id.title: Deal Id

idempotency_key.description: Requester-minted opaque key (UUID recommended). Same key -> same response, no duplicate side effects (FD-12). Reusing a key with a different body is an idempotency_conflict error.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

order_id.description: Order being modified; at least one of order_id/deal_id.
order_id.title: Order Id

proposed_values.description: Field -> proposed new value. For change_type 'cancellation': cancel_pct (0.0-1.0), reason, effective_date.
proposed_values.title: Proposed Values
